capabilities: Lay out the active note's parents, children, jumps, and siblings as a centered graph
Create links by dragging handles between note cards
Edit parent/child/jump page properties in place, including YAML frontmatter and prefilled template fields
disambiguation: Not an AI or neuroscience tool; the name refers to the links between notes, laid out in a TheBrain-style spatial graph.
extras: Also runs in Logseq (0.10.x Markdown/file graph) as an unpacked plugin; beta versions installable via BRAT; README states the plugin was written with LLM assistance.
intentEvidence: its page-property data model (parent:: / child:: / jump::, declared one direction with reciprocals inferred) is the basis
problem: Obsidian's graph shows the whole vault and links must be edited in note text, making focused navigation and link editing awkward.

relations.evidence: its spatial "Plex" interface, with the active note centered and its relations fanning out around it, is the inspiration
its inline-field index and query API are how the Obsidian adapter reads parent:: / child:: / jump:: links
a host application this extends; it provides the Markdown graph, page properties, and plugin platform

summary: Focused graph view that lays out the active note's parent, child, and jump links around it, with click navigation and in-place link editing.
